versions.content: Semantics of FMFeatureDecomposition Let S be a set of FMFeature s and let f; f 1 ; f 2 ; : : : ; f n be FMFeature s where f is the parent feature for f 1 ; f 2 ; : : : ; f n . Furthermore, let d be the FMFeatureDecomposition that is aggre- gated by f in the role decomposition where ⌊ f 1 ; f 2 ; : : : ; f n g are all referenced from d in the role feature . Based on the category of the FMFeatureDecomposition d , the following condi- tions are defined: MANDATORYFEATURE f 2 S ,j ⌊ f 1 ; f 2 ; : : : ; f n g \ S j = n OPTIONALFEATURE f 2 S , 0 j ⌊ f 1 ; f 2 ; : : : ; f n g \ S j  n ALTERNATIVEFEATURE f 2 S ,j ⌊ f 1 ; f 2 ; : : : ; f n g \ S j = 1 MULTIPLEFEATURE f 2 S , min  j ⌊ f 1 ; f 2 ; : : : ; f n g \ S j  max
